name: CrossWatch
description: CrossWatch synchronizes media activity between Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and supported tracking services, with scheduled syncs, realtime monitoring, webhooks, captures and management tools.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent CrossWatch configuration and application data, mounted inside the container at /config.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP port used to access the CrossWatch web interface.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used for scheduling and displayed timestamps.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: Numeric user ID used to run CrossWatch. The Unraid default is 99.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: Numeric group ID used to run CrossWatch. The Unraid default is 100.
